late_arrival_policy: More than 15 minutes late: the appointment may be rescheduled
cancellation_policy: Please cancel at least 4 hours before your appointment.
walkin_policy: Walk-ins are accepted when capacity allows and may have a longer wait.
emergency_policy: Medical emergencies should go to the nearest emergency department.
noshow_policy: Repeated no-shows may require confirmation before future bookings.
special_conditions: Appointments are for one patient and one doctor.
